merkbox.usage: geplante, sichere Handlungen in der (nahen) Zukunft
merkbox.question: (question word +) Am/Is/Are + … + going to + verb

exercises.title: Your parents are going to spend their weekend in a hotel. You and your siblings stay at home. Here are your plans.

items.prompt: Ben: ✓ tidy up his room · ✗ clean the hamster cage again
Ann: ✓ have tennis match · ✗ listen to music all the time
I: ✓ prepare the party · ✗ invite Peter Parker
we: ✓ enjoy our weekend · ✗ think of our parents

items.text: I {} (visit) my grandparents at the weekend.
Ann is sure that she {} (eat) sweets all the time.
I {} (not/swim) at the club on Saturday evening.
{} Ann {} (make) a cake for the party?
Ben and Ann {} (not/come) to my party, they {} (watch) TV.

items.prompt: Who are you going to invite? (my friends)
When are the guests going to come? (8 p.m.)
Where is the party going to take place? (garden)
What are you going to do at the party? (dance, have fun, not do homework)
